summary: Six citizens stranded by severe highway destruction in Northern Colorado were spotted and rescued by Colorado Army National Guard helicopter crews (UH-60 Black Hawk and LUH-72 Lakota) during Governor Hickenlooper's September 14 damage-assessment flight over the flood zone
notes: County left blank: flight covered Boulder, Longmont, Estes Park, Lyons, and Hwy 34 along the Big Thompson River; rescue location not specified; September 2013 Front Range flood
